title: Count Routes to Climb a Rectangular Grid
summary: Count routes through available dot cells of a rectangular grid, starting on its bottom row and ending on its top row. A move goes to a different available cell in the same row or the immediately preceding row, with Euclidean distance at most d. Two horizontal moves cannot be consecutive. Return the route count modulo 1000000007.
officialConstraints: Rows and columns each range from 1 through 750; d is an integer from 1 through 750; cells are dot or hash.
pitfalls: A horizontal move is allowed on the top row before finishing. The one-row example includes singleton routes and both horizontal directions. Do not count staying in the same cell as a move.
interpretationNotes: Distinct-cell moves and singleton routes are confirmed by the official one-row example; the prose alone is less explicit.
